obn_steward.text: The MacDougalls are one of the oldest clans in Scotland, lords of Lorn, and Dunollie has been their seat for about eight centuries.
In 1306 the clan fought Robert the Bruce at Dalrigh and took his brooch, a big silver and crystal thing known as the Brooch of Lorn. Bruce got his own back in time. The brooch is still famous.

obn_castle_piper.text: I play at the gate on Saturdays. The acoustics in the keep are wonderful. The neighbours haven't made their minds up.
